verdict.rationale: iTerm2 natively supports splitting tabs into multiple panes (vertical/horizontal) and organizing sessions across tabs and windows, directly replacing the need for tmux/screen for basic pane-and-tab workflows, with session restoration and profile-based organization further supporting this. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of pane-splitting workflow (community evidence focuses on other features like imgcat/scripting rather than confirming multiplexing usability directly).
